fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Gallops 8 tiles to a target and strikes it, which deals 16 damage and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tamped Seam
fusions.desc: A tamping strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target, and uses it up.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Run
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Paced Gallop
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 10% higher, and you have 8% earth resistance.
